// diagnostic

E0384

Jet has no membership operator here; `in` only joins a source-loop binding to its source.

What

Jet has no membership operator here; `in` only joins a source-loop binding to its source.

Why

Expression `x in xs` has no operator meaning in Jet. Collection membership is a method call.

Fix

Write `xs.contains(x)` (the `.contains(x)` method) instead of `x in xs`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0384: tests/ui/in_membership_retired.stderr.
